_comment: Battle halls on Examiner Hollis's board (KAMPF_PLAN_1000 area 'Endgame-Kampfmodi'). Read by scripts/core/BattleHalls.gd. Everyone fights with copies on ring (level scaling), so nothing is lost and no shop seal, amulet or pass counts. kind: random (lottery team), draft (pick from a pool), survival (no healing between rounds), tower (floors, front = [player, foe], foe_team per floor), boss (one Rift heart per floor), prism (one prism boss a week). The field turns per round from fields, the rule variant per week. festival: only open while a festival runs, foes only of its elements. Waymarks once per hall and week for a clear; title, lore line and a Hall of Fame row on the first clear.
_card_titles: Every title a player can earn (hall clears, Spirlog goals, bonus goals) and so wear on the Wanderer card. tools/online/game_data_sql.py loads them as known_ids kind 'title'; the server keeps no other title (no free text). tests/unit/test_battle_halls.gd checks the list is complete.

halls.label: Lottery Hall
halls.intro: Three strangers at Ring 50 are handed to you at the door. The hall calls it luck. The strangers call it Tuesday.
halls.title: Lottery Winner
halls.lore: The Lottery Hall was built by a guild that lost a bet. Nobody remembers who won, only who had to pay for the roof.

halls.label: Draft Hall
halls.intro: Eight Spirlings on the table. You pick, the echo picks, you pick again. Whatever is left over fights for the other side.
halls.title: First Pick
halls.lore: In the Draft Hall the echoes keep a list of every Spirling you passed over. They read it out loud. Slowly.

halls.label: Long Night
halls.intro: Twelve rounds, no healing, no breaks. Your team at Ring 50 walks in. How many walk out is your business.
halls.title: Still Standing
halls.lore: The Long Night has a door at the end. Somebody painted 'exit' on it as a joke. It is not a joke. It is just very far away.

halls.label: Twin Stair
halls.intro: Seven floors, two at a time on each side. Bring four. Bring friends, if you still have any.
halls.title: Two-Handed
halls.lore: The Twin Stair was built by two brothers who never spoke again after it was finished. Every floor is a little crooked, out of spite.

halls.label: Swarm Stair
halls.intro: Seven floors of swarms. They are smaller than you. There are just so many of them.
halls.title: Swarm Breaker
halls.lore: Nobody built the Swarm Stair. It grew. The keeper insists it is a building. The keeper is mostly fed by the swarm.

halls.label: Heart Stair
halls.intro: One Rift heart per floor, three hearts, no healing in between. They remember being sealed. They took it personally.
halls.title: Heartbreaker
halls.lore: The Rift hearts on the Heart Stair are echoes too. They know it. That is the part that makes them angry.

halls.label: Prism Heart
halls.intro: This week a Rift heart wears a prism skin. It is beautiful, and it would very much like you dead.
halls.title: Prism Hunter
halls.lore: Prism hearts are what a Rift dreams of when it dreams of being admired. Nobody admires it for long.

halls.label: Festival Cup
halls.intro: The festival cup: four rounds against Spirlings of the festival's elements. The prize is honour. The honour is made of tin.
halls.title: Cup Bearer
halls.lore: The Festival Cup is the same cup every year. It has been dropped, dented and once used as a bucket. It still counts.
